templates.name: Tactical Asset Allocation - dual momentum (Antonacci)
templates.methodology: Absolute + relative momentum across low-correlation asset-class ETFs, monthly rebalance, negative absolute momentum rotates to cash/bonds

entry_rule.text: Rank universe by trailing 6-month total return; hold top-5 while absolute momentum > 0; rotate negative-momentum slots to AGG

evidence.note: top5-6m cell 2007-2026; 9m region Sharpe 1.09-1.21. Smart-beta risk-adjusted gain, NOT excess return; in-sample-robust, forward-track before sizing.

templates.name: High-dividend, low-beta quality equity
templates.methodology: Dividend capture + low-volatility anomaly (Frazzini-Pedersen) + quality factor (Novy-Marx)

entry_rule.text: Code-backed: SafetyGate Altman Z'' >= 1.10 AND Beneish M <= -1.78, universe gates mcap >= $300M / >=5y operating / 10-K <= 540d / not Financial-or-Utilities, Piotroski F in QualityComposite. Proposed (NOT coded): yield >= 2.5%, beta <= 0.8, Piotroski F >= 7 hard gates.

exit_rule.text: Thesis-break rules via pick contract; proposed: dividend cut / 2 consecutive earnings misses / beta > 1.2

evidence.note: Closest candidate: n and WR gates pass live (n=229, WR 55.9%); binding failure PF 0.8365 < 1.5

templates.name: Commodity carry - normal backwardation / roll yield
templates.methodology: Keynesian normal backwardation: long commodities in backwardation (positive roll yield)

entry_rule.text: Code: backwardation proxy = price above SMA, long top-3 strongest carry. Proposed refinement: positive roll yield AND 3-month momentum > 0.

evidence.note: n=227 clears; WR 40.1% and PF 1.0281 fail. Class frozen at intake (BLOCKED_ASSET_CLASSES, 0.0 volume cap).

templates.name: Forex carry trade (G10 rate differential)
templates.methodology: Long high-yield vs short low-yield currencies (Burnside-Hanson-Jagannathan)

entry_rule.text: Long high-yield, short low-yield. Proposed: vol-target 10% annualized (NOT coded).

evidence.note: Gross PF 1.79 / CI-LB 1.35 dies at ~1bp round-trip cost (net PF 0.46 @ 5bp) - reports/FOREX_NETCOST_CILB_SENSITIVITY_2026-06-13.md. Live: n=547 but WR 30.7% / PF 0.6111. NOT the 'PF 0.460 ledger' of the original draft - that row is EQUITY.

templates.name: Crypto stable-coin inflow signal + funding-rate arbitrage
templates.methodology: On-chain flow regime signal (Glassnode free tier, NOT Santiment) + perpetual funding-rate basis capture

entry_rule.text: USDT/USDC inflow > 2x 7-day avg -> long BTC/ETH 24-48h; funding > +0.05%/8h -> short perp / long spot; funding < -0.03%/8h -> long perp / short spot
proposed_rules: stable-coin inflow > 2x 7-day average (on-chain momentum module uses Glassnode MVRV-Z/active addresses instead)
